headline: United's hubs are running normally; no FAA programs are in effect.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 86% on time or better.

Not in effect now: the FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET, and a ground delay program is possible for flights into San Francisco tomorrow after 9:00 AM PT.
